programs.description: When Balram seizes a cache of arms and ammunition, his investigations lead him to a criminal, Tharadas. However, it is not easy for Balram to catch Tharadas until he involves his girlfriend.

Irshad and Haseeb, two teenage boys from Mattanchery, share a passion for pigeon flying, a local game. Later, Irshad opens up about a tragic incident that ruined many friendships in the neighbourhood.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.
Harinarayanan, a young man who works in Chennai, is in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich couple. However, he and his family are forced to bear the burden of tradition.
Two school-going brothers seem to exhibit the same level of patriotism their military father possessed when they decide to follow a potential lead on a terrorist, but for personal reasons.

After Subramanian has to leave his aged father alone to go to Russia, he returns with a robot to take care of him. Even though hesitant at first, his father soon develops a strong bond with the robot.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
Ryan Philip is a mischievous 8-year-old who struggles with math and his strict teacher Pappan. However, everything changes when he discovers a magical pen that helps him solve all his problems.
An undercover Indian operative infiltrates the dangerous criminal network of Karachi's Lyari suburb. However, he must systematically climb through the ranks to destroy it from within.
Aswathy, who belongs to a royal family with dark secrets, falls in love with Vinod. However, strange events begin occurring after Aswathy mysteriously dies during childbirth.

Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.
Dr. Ruben Isaac takes up a position in a psychiatric hospital and uses humanitarian methods to treat his patients. However, things take a turn when his real identity is uncovered.

A hard-working postwoman lives a contended life with her adopted son. However, her simple life is jeopardised after her beloved son is imprisoned under a false charge.
A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.
Unni, who wishes to become a scriptwriter, learns that a director is hospitalised in his locality. He meets him to narrate his story about Amal, a heartbroken man who plans to start life afresh.
Passion and conflict intertwine in the turbulent relationship of a strong-willed couple, forging an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.
A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world.
Narayanan, a young man, goes to Dubai to make a living. However, he faces many struggles but braves them for the sake of his family's well-being.

Roy, Amir, Soorya and Gauri are four cancer patients seeking treatment at the same hospital. They become friends and decide to help each other fulfil their dreams.
A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.
Neil, a showroom executive, finds a bag full of money after a party. Later, he receives a call to meet at a secluded spot where he finds four strangers and gets involved in a dangerous deal.
Kalarikkal Achuthankutty and Pattarumatathil Najeeb are best friends and run an event management company. But soon they part ways because Najeeb secretly marries Achuthankutty's sister Athira.
Roopesh, a media executive, falls in love with Kabani, a trainee who works her way up to become a news presenter. A set of unforeseen events changes their personal and professional lives.
Michael and his family buy a farm that is coveted by a rich man, who makes life difficult for him. Thereafter, Michael's brother, Chandy, comes to support him.
After moving to Chennai, four individuals cross paths while chasing success in the city. However, when a ruthless gangster threatens them, they join forces to take him down.
Saraswathiyamma is the head of a noble family that treats her servant Krishnan as one of her own sons. When her relatives conspire to sell her house, she and Krishnan set out to save it.

Daya Shankar, a courageous police officer, befriends Geevarghese, a notorious criminal, and earns his trust. However, things get complicated after the policeman reveals the real reason for his friendship.

Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
A girl from a wealthy family falls in love with a poor boy from her college. However, things take a turn when her disapproving mother sends thugs to kill her lover.
The lives of two martial arts instructors are upended when they become the targets of a gang, who decide to assassinate the brother and sister duo.
After a radio jockey loses his voice due to excessive smoking, he walks on a difficult path to regain it by correcting his mistakes.
Simon, an ardent Vijay fan, along with his friends, crosses paths with Arjunan and his brother who are petty criminals. Later, he decides to fight Arjunan and end his reign in the city.
When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.
Three inseparable friends chase ambitious dreams but choose risky shortcuts to achieve them. Subsequently, unforeseen winds of fate force them to face the consequences of their choices.
Siddharthan helps a girl named Pooja to fight her haunted past, which includes her sadist husband and mother. Later, he helps her to move forward in life.
Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.

Notorious for his relationships with women, a single Kuttiyappan's life takes a turn when he sets out to fulfil one of his strange dreams.
Manu, Meera, Rafeeq, Ashok and Vijayakumar study together in a college. The five friends share a close bond and are always willing to fight for each other.
Shajahan struggles to make ends meet after suffering a huge loss in his duty-free shop. His friend Neeraj, who aspires to become a director, ropes Shajahan into his idea of making an adult film.
Narayankutty wishes to be a lawyer but ends up being a clerk in a government office. However, when he sees the law being breached or misused, he does not hesitate to raise his voice against it.
Paul, a student from Thrissur, joins Maharaja's College in Ernakulam where he befriends Subhash. Along with him, they strive to reintroduce the SFY party on campus.
During the Mamangam fair, a new legend is born when a 12-year-old boy, Chandroth Valiya Panikkar, survives a battle with the mighty army of Zamorin.
When a taxi driver begins to experience various eerie events in his vehicle, he strives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious occurrences.
Travelling from Mumbai to Pune in a four-wheeler, a motley crew of unlikely heroes must race against time to deliver a heart to a 13-year-old patient.
Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.

Two men without any specific aim, desire to be policemen. One day, they happen to cross paths with Joy, an undercover police officer, and decide to help him out.
Abraham and Lincoln are drawn into a turbulent world of crime and loyalty, where personal choices and past ties shape their unpredictable path.
Mahadevan is a live witness of Radhika's hit-and-run accident. His helpful gesture of taking Radhika to the hospital, however, lands him in trouble when he is confronted by Meera, Radhika's friend.
Without knowing the risk of his work, a man goes to a village to dig a well as they are facing water scarcity. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with a girl.
Rani and Padmini, two women with different agendas, embark on an unfamiliar journey while getting to know each other and help each other through personal conflicts.
Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.
A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.

The villagers of Vellimala force the government to build a dam in their village. However, when the dam becomes unsafe, the government decides to destroy it, leading to violent protests by the villagers.

A WWI veteran becomes a postman and delivers letters and money orders to the families of soldiers. However, his visits soon turn into a bad omen when WWII breaks out.
Pandian falls in love with his neighbour, Maithili, and anonymously helps her continue her education. However, Pandian's roommate, Prakash, gets all the credits for his good deeds.
While looking to borrow money to meet his wife's medical expenses, Durgaprasad uncovers a deadly terrorist plot and must act to save the city from destruction.
A man sets out to investigate the death of his brother at a haunted house, leading him to come across several supernatural experiences.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
Ajayan comes back to his village to be with his ailing mother. However, things get strange when a boy comes to his house claiming to be his son.
When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.
Madhavan is an honest and hardworking man. However, when a rich man's daughter, Eliana, asks him to abduct her and demand a ransom from her father, his life turns upside down.

Prakashan, after drinking, encounters Vinod and a young woman near a carpenter's abode. Subsequently, both men, Prakashan and Venu, perceive this duo as an affectionate couple, suspecting the woman is Nirmala.
